cmd: python3 -c "import duckdb;d=duckdb.sql(\"select date_part('hour',timezone('Europe/Warsaw',(purchase_date+transaction_time_gmt)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int h,count(*) n from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where tran_id_gmt_tm<>'000000' group by 1 order by n desc limit 1\").fetchone();print(d[0])"

statement: Share of trade between 11:00 and 15:00 local.
cmd: python3 -c "import duckdb;d=duckdb.sql(\"select date_part('hour',timezone('Europe/Warsaw',(purchase_date+transaction_time_gmt)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int h,count(*) n from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where tran_id_gmt_tm<>'000000' group by 1\").df();print(round(100*d[d.h.between(11,15)].n.sum()/d.n.sum(),1))"

statement: Postcodes passing the >=3 merchants gate.
cmd: python3 -c "import duckdb;print(duckdb.sql(\"select count(*) from (select merchant_postal_code_normalized pc,count(distinct mrch_nm_raw) m from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where merchant_postal_code_normalized is not null group by 1) where m>=3\").fetchone()[0])"

statement: Postcodes passing all three privacy gates.
cmd: python3 -c "import duckdb;print(duckdb.sql(\"with per as (select merchant_postal_code_normalized pc,mrch_nm_raw m,count(*) n from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where merchant_postal_code_normalized is not null group by 1,2), agg as (select pc,sum(n) tot,count(*) merchants,max(n) top1 from per group by 1), cards as (select merchant_postal_code_normalized pc,count(distinct pymt_crd_acct_num_raw) cards from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where merchant_postal_code_normalized is not null group by 1) select count(*) from agg a join cards c using(pc) where c.cards>=30 and a.merchants>=3 and a.top1*1.0/a.tot<=0.75\").fetchone()[0])"

statement: Share of transaction volume inside the postcodes that pass all three gates.
cmd: python3 -c "import duckdb;print(round(duckdb.sql(\"with per as (select merchant_postal_code_normalized pc,mrch_nm_raw m,count(*) n from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where merchant_postal_code_normalized is not null group by 1,2), agg as (select pc,sum(n) tot,count(*) merchants,max(n) top1 from per group by 1), cards as (select merchant_postal_code_normalized pc,count(distinct pymt_crd_acct_num_raw) cards from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where merchant_postal_code_normalized is not null group by 1) select 100.0*sum(case when c.cards>=30 and a.merchants>=3 and a.top1*1.0/a.tot<=0.75 then a.tot else 0 end)/sum(a.tot) from agg a join cards c using(pc)\").fetchone()[0],1))"

statement: Share of all transactions sitting in postcode 81-777.
cmd: python3 -c "import duckdb;print(round(duckdb.sql(\"select 100.0*count(*)/(select count(*) from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet'])) from read_parquet(['/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part01.parquet','/Users/kulma/Downloads/mcc5812_transactions.part02.parquet']) where merchant_postal_code_normalized='81-777'\").fetchone()[0],1))"
